review_description: Believe Solar Sunwerx no longer exist?My 3 kW system consists of 12 Eco Future solar panels and a Solax 3.3 kW Dual MPPT inverter .

Having purchased a 16 x 250w Topsola panel and 5 kw Growatt inverter PV system in June 2015 from Solar Sunwerx (at Solar Quotes recommendation), I now understand that Solar Sunwerx went into voluntary liquidation in September 2015. So much for the 10 year workmanship warranty that was included in my contract! I was and remain satisfied with the installation and can only hope that the manufacturers warranties for the panels and inverter are honoured if required in the future.

Solar Sunwerx sent their best installer Lloyd to perform remediation on a badly installed system from another company I do not wish to name.  The panels themselves were poorly mounted, and in a location where shading from a tree was affecting performance to a large degree for seven months out of twelve.Lloyd and Jamie resited the panels to the south roof with tilt frames facing North to remove nearly all shading issues.  There were some small electrical issues resolved and obviously in resiting the panels were remounted properly unlike initially.The remediation work was on the pricey side even allowing for the cost of tilt frames.  The price for the system is what Solar Sunwerx would have charged for the install inc. tilt frames, panels and inverter - unfortunately the remediation work plus the first installerâ€™s cost was about a third more than this price.

Had 2 systems installed by this company1st  paperwork wasn't done properly have had troubles ever since ,getting feed in tariff ,then had fire in dc isolators almost burnt the business down!2nd installed in home has had cracked solar panelsTwice bitten  never to recommend or use again no help from company!Judging by reviews this isn't isolated!
All companies who quoted gave me professional and timely responses.  All offered what we felt were very similar quality products and services, so the final choice was based essentially on cost.
Have not had system long enough to rate value or quality but it all seems very good.Thank you for your assistanceBrian
Using your site, references and checklists is a must before making a final decision.

Solar Sunwerx visited and were very professional and answered all questions authoritatively and did some creative problem solving at the visit. Their range of panels and inverters includes innovative technology and I was confident in their research material and vetting of gear. Sufficient to go with a Solax inverter with wifi live monitoring of output (via website on mobile or iPad or PC - and it works a treat!). Hope it has longevity too!  The installer was fantastic and came when he said he would and did a very smooth job. The paperwork was completed within 24 hours and the system certified within a couple of days!  I received a professional set of instructions and a kit of information. I have only had the system 8 weeks but couldn't be happier and highly recommend Solar Sunwerx.

Do not use solar sunwerx.  They installed a system at my place a few years ago.  Still under warranty an item called a DC isolator burned out. On inspection it was installed incorrectly and not in accordance with australian standard. Solar sunwerx refuse to fix the problem.

Unfortunately this company went through a "Restructure" is what they called it, but we were caught in the crossfire, many delays and a lot of uncertainty we final got our system installed over a month later from signing on, tho they did get it here and installed my confidence in this company is still very negative, but on the plus side there installer Lloyd is a sharp operator, very professional and quality workmanship, I highly recommend him but cannot give the same glowing review for Solar Sunwerx

Solar Sunwerx were the first to respond, visit and provide a quotation. I had prepared a detailed list of questions and they were the only supplier who replied in detail to all the questions in an email.

The company is very diligent and so far I would give them top scores. The installation will take place next week and they made sure that everything is ready and on hand well ahead of time. So far I am very happy with them. I must add that True Value had a slightly better price on offer but they ignored all my e-mails for a while. I do not regret my choice.

Solar Sunwerx were genuine, with good installers and a reasonable price - yes you can get better systems - but will they pay back any faster - No!Just get a reasonable system from a Local genuine company with a bit of history for an affordable price, and then knuckle down and make the Solar work for you.Do your own maths - you know how much you use and when - my estimate is that the system will pay for itself in 2.8 years.  It will take some effort to maximise the Solar - but that's why I committed to it.
We are pleased with the result and happy we chose this company. They were professional and we have no problems to date.

We went for a 4.4 Kw system as well as an evacuated tube solar hotwater system, it was all installed in one day and up and running.The installers weere fast, efficient and cleaned up, didn't even know they had been, apart from the panels up on the roof :-)The solar hotwater stopped working after the first day, and it was a dud thermostat, the wife was a bit upset that they couldn't fix it on the day, but they ended up coming out the next afternoon and installed the replacement part.

We did not go with the cheapest quote. After looking at the various inverters and panels offered and the professionalism of the sales people, we went with Solar Sunwerx. It proved to be a good decision. They were very professional before, during and after the installation. They recommended a Wifi model invertor and monitoring program, along with a smart meter monitoring program from our electricity supplier. The combination of these two software packages has allowed us to get a good idea on how much and when we use power. We are then able to adjust our time of day usage to our solar generation.
very nice mob to deal withcompetitive price and professional neat installation.actually 5.5 kw of panels (22 Jinko panels) run through a 5kw Solax inverter fully installed for $6150

From the moment Solar Sunwerx visited to completion of installation, the service was first class.  I had many questions, and many reservations, as I knew very little about the mechanics of solar energy.  After Michael's (our salesman) first visit, I had acquired enough information to make an informed decision.  Michael was also readily available to answer numerous questions after his visit.  I received quotes from two other companies, neither provided the level of time that Solar Sunwerx did.  Once I'd signed the order, Solar Sunwerx walked me through every step of the process, advised in writing what to expect and a timeline that was spot on.  The sub-contractors who installed the unit (Jinko 205W panels and Solax 3kW Single MPPT Inverter) were professional, efficient and spent time communicating what will happen once they leave the property.  To add to the already excellent service I received, Michael popped in on his way home to check how installation went and if I was happy.  Of course, the delay is with the power distributor and signing off on the feed-in tariff.  After 3 weeks, I'm still waiting for them to do their job.
I found Gryphon  too "pushy" and  the sales rep arrived late.

Every company who contacted me said "do you have any other questions "Even after reading your site I still didn't have the insight needed to ask the really important questions .what happens next !Its been 5 weeks now since installation I'm still waiting for my energy company to give me the go ahead.I have missed summer  and can only hope we have a good Autumn .

I really cannot fault the service and quality we got from Solar Sunwerx. We had done a lot of research and used Solar Quotes to discover a lot about systems before deciding on what we wanted. Some companies tried to talk us out of what we knew was best but Solar Sunwerx worked with us, advised us intelligently and helped us design the best system for our situation. And, to top it off, they were much less expensive than similar systems from other companies. When the installers came they were quick, friendly and professional. They did a great job - so much so that the electrical inspector said it was one of the best installs he'd seen. A great company with great service. Highly recommended.
Very professional setup and kept informed of progress and inspections done promptly.
The price range above is limited to $10K to 15K. Our system was in the low $11K - so pretty fine value for money for a 5.32KW system.

I was expecting maybe a problem or two after signing up but installation was fast . . The crew turned up on time and finished the same day. The people at Solar Sunwerx were reassuring and patiently answered any questions I had. They said what they would do and they did what they said.5 stars to Finn at Solar Quotes, too. Excellent, friendly service and wealth of information.

We have a lot of shade on our roof at various times of the year. Also it has two levels and many small and angled areas. We asked the three suppliers recommended by this website to quote. All three refused the dimensioned drawing of the roof instead relying on photos from nearmap.com or similar. Sunwerx offered an ac system that dealt with the shade best. The others offered the traditional dc systems  where several panels in a row are limited in performance by the least performing panel unlike the ac type. We also liked the APS controller with feedback on each panels performance in realtime. The unfortunate part was that only 1.5kW was installed when 3kW was quoted. When Sunwerx's most trusted and very qualified installer got on the roof he could only fit half the panels. Otherwise the installation and follow up paperwork has been handled efficiently and we have produced 829kWh since it was officially switched on in Jan 2014

Very impressed with knowledge of supplier during home visit and his willingness to assist answer my questions. Although our system has yet to be installed, I am very satisfied at this time and would like to state my great appreciation for the assistance of F. Peacock and his web-site!!! Would be pleased to provide a personal reference for both F. Peacock and/or Sunwerx to anyone thinking of obtaining solar power.

Customer service has been good all along.Installer very helpful and cheerful.System has not yet been accredited by our supplier.Although system is rated at 3kW the best output we seem to get (March) is about 2.8kW.We have averaged an output of about 11.5kWh/day during March.The above ratings are very subjective as we have only had the system for 3 weeks.
Great guys, service and follow up. Highly recommend.

Solar Sunwerx were the only ones to respond and give me a quote. I don't know what happened to the other 2 that were supposed to get in touch with me through your site.I had already got 3 quotes myself and were very impressed with Daniel from Sunwerx as well as Sam and his installation crew.  It all went ahead on the day of my choice and they were punctual and did an excellent job.Information was forthcoming at every stage from Carol in the office.It was an enjoyable experience and now we are waiting for Aus Net to re configure the meter. Even then Carol said if it doesn't happen in three weeks, ring her and she will sort it out.This is old fashioned service that should be applauded in this day and age. Thanks Finn for putting them in touch with me.
Good value for money, working very well.

The sales consultant - Graham knows his product and takes the time to make sure the system will best fit the users' needs.  Sam and the installation team could not have been more professional / helpful.

The panels weren't available on the install date, so all the installation was done minus the panels initially. I had plenty of communication with Sunwerx so it was just a matter of waiting another week for the panels.

One quote was a shocker, pushy and refused to come out unless we purchased from him, offered a 20c per KW rebate which we later found out had many strings attached. Continually telephoned and said he wasn't going to visit unless we signed up.Other companies were polite and helpful.
Thanks for your service and the information resources you provide

Very efficient company to deal with. Gave us all the information we asked for.  The installers were excellent and clean.  The system is working just waiting now for the Provider to do their bit, I understand that can take a bit of time.  We'll see.

Delays in connection inspections between the energy retailer and the distributor are frustrating, as are the limited connection plans to get started - but these issues were beyond the direct control of the solar company.Solar Sunwerx have been exceptional in their communication and advice, especially in providing detailed information (hard copy and web-based) to answer all our questions - there have been no 'hidden' costs or false expectations; a thoroughly professional (and personable) team.

System is working as per monitor, however the bureaucratic system to start using the power generated is very slow, took 2 weeks for inspection, now waiting on power supplier to notify us that it has been allocated to our account.

Solar Sunwerx exceeded my expectations in every aspect of the transaction.Professional sales, excellent documentation, on time every time and I believe the hardware they installed is of good to very good quality.The Installer was great also, came when scheduled, completed his install and documentation promptly.If only every retailer could emulate the great service demonstrated by Solar Sunwerx in my case, there would be few consumer issues.

Hi Finn, thank you for your service.Our system was installed last Monday and is not yet fully operational, so I can't really comment too much.Solar Sunwerx was the only company which actually came to the site to look at our options.  The salesman was not pushy and had lots of useful information.  Only time will tell if we made a good decision!  Previous customers were happy to recommend them.  The installer did a very neat job, was knowledgeable, cheerful, considerate, and willing to dodge rain showers.Mark Group made an appointment but did not turn up.  I can't remember if Metro replied or not.
Not really, still waiting on the upgraded meter.

We went with Solar Sunwerx based on reviews and meeting the sales person. We have had a very positive experience all round. The installer was very approachable and competent. The follow-up paperwork which was handled speedily and efficiently.
The system has been installed for over a month. I rang the Sunwerx three times. They did not contact me. I am still waiting for the system to be operational!

We had prices from 12 companies. 3 through your site, 7 through another website, and 2 separate companies.  5 of the 12 made site inspections and provided written quotes.Nicholls Solar did not come to site. They sent emailed prices, then followed up MUCH later.Sunstainable came to site & provided quotes. Helpful but a bit slow to respond.

As our system has only been installed today I can only comment on the service we have received so far. We have been very happy with all our dealings with Solar Sunwerx. It was turned on for the first time just before 5pm and immediately it began producing up to 3.5 kilowatts.

Salesman (Daniel) was very informative & the installer (Sam & his crew) were very quick & cleaned up after themselves.There was a  minor problem that had to be rectified before the inspector passed the installation, but this was all completed within 3 weeks of ordering the system.Can't give a rating on the quality of the system yet as there is currently a 50 working day delay before SP Austnet can process their paperwork to have the Smart (Dumb) metre re-calibrated.

Solar Sunwerx were transparent through the whole process. Daniel was very honest & everything he said about installation dates, processing of the paperwork & general information were spot on.We had our system installed by Frank 10th sept & just recently have been put on the TFiT.The savings have been instantaneous. Be warned this solar generation stuff is addictive especially when you can monitor your consumption through the various portals now available via the smart meter.I would highly recommend Solar Sunwerx. Another happy customer.
Mark Group basically tried to justify their higher price by bad-mouthing the opposition, Bradford solar didn't even bother to respond.  Overall, Solar Sunwerx were great.

Rated quality as average because only time will tell if satisfactory or not. There were no apparent problems with service and installation but I'm still waiting for distributor, Powercor to adjust meter. The amount quoted by TRUenergy for latter operation was >$800. Existing meter is new 2011 and Powercor advise they only have to make minor adjustment and follow-up check. When system is actually operating at the feed-in tariff I expect I intend to dispute the excessived meter adjustment charge.

The sale & installation cycle by Solar Sunwerx was/has been first class. The sales rep Aram Cargill is a professoinal with a passion for sustainability & is prepared to discuss your needs/wants & misunderstandings regarding renewable energy face to face.  My experience with others was not as forthcoming as they seemed to be locked into their phones & email & if I am going to spend a chunk of money I want to see who I am dealing with.. The installation was done within 2 weeks of sale with again a professional, but personal approach, from all the Solar Sunwerx staff involved.Once we handed all the paper work over to the retailer & distibutor we have dissolved into a noxious mist as they bounce the paperwok around and leaves me still without my solar panels feeding into the grid some 6-8 weeks later.
Great service from sales team, installer was very professional and informative system working brilliantly.

My system was in fact 2.88kw.  The sales person spent a lot of time with me and went to a lot of trouble to satisfy my needs.  I was going for a Chinese inverter, which seemed on specs. to be good, but not a long history.  Sunwerx came up a deal for Xantrex inverter for not much more.They used a contractor in my case, who I couldn't speak highly enough of.  He, to my eye was very competent.  He went to a great deal of trouble make a neat job, putting the inverter where I wanted it and lined  up the panels perfectly even though my so called flat roof had a bend in it.I would like also to commend Green Earth Electrical for the thoroughness of their quote. Did a complete analysis of my bills and excellent projections.In the end price one out.

Their systems aren't the cheapest but they are excellent quality and the customer service from Peter Williams and his installers was terrific. They delivered on everything they promised and even came back as promised to remove a roof pipe that was shadowing the panels many weeks after installation.  Their point of difference was that they don't sub-contract the installation which means if there are any problems with the installation, there is no chasing up a third party.

I found Solar Sunwerx to be very professional and efficient and they have provided excellent customer service.  They have kept me informed at every step of the process and have met all of their promised timeframes.  The guys undertaking the installation were very professional and keen to ensure I was happy with the positioning of the hardware and cabling etc.  When initially researching solar power I was somewhat concerned about reports of unsatisfactory experiences that some people have had but Solar Sunwerx have made this a completely stress free process including dealing with my electricity retailer and wholesaler.  While perhaps not the cheapest available, their price was nevertheless very competitive and I would have no hesitation of recommending Solar Sunwerx to other prospective customers.

They installed the solar panels with long screws which went through the ceiling of my bedroom and put the interactive control panel above the roof of my wood shed where l would need a ladder to read it!BUTAfter talking to them they did then come and repair the ceiling and relocate the inverter

Great result but three factors made it an experience:1. Suppliers quoted products that they couldn't supply - meaning that I had to reverse my decision to go with one supplier2. delay post-signing contract meant I felt that we had been promised things that weren't going to be delivered in the timeframe. We got it early as they had a cancellation.3. lack of overall coordination between elec retailer, elec distributor and Solar PV supplier meant that I didn't know who had submitted paperwork to whom and when. This meant that although I had it installed and operational in mid Feb 2010, Retailer forms were signed in Mid March and the Distributor didn't visit the site to OK it till 03 May 2010. As I was in the industry I knew who to call and what to ask and when to tell them they didn't know what they were talking about.Excellent workmanship and products supplied.I'd be happy to discuss the subject with others trying to navigate the minefield of Solar installations.
The technical advice I received from Solar Sunwerx was very helpful. The installers were great,they arrived on time and cleaned up after. I would recommend Solar Sunwerx.

With the help of your website solarquotes and the information it provided it was much easier to enable a satisfactory outcome to the installation however we are finding the red tape surrounding the tying in of the installation to the grid and the slowness of this process to be a real bummer.It is totally frustrating to have a workable installation which you have paid for that you cannot use literally for a couple of months because you are waiting for inspectors then distribution companies to do their work.I think people need to know this and if you have any clues on how to hurry up organisations such as SP Ausnet they would be welcome.
Installation crew arrived on time and the work appeared to be done in a professional manner. It's a bit too early for a more detailed assessment.

My experience with Solar Sunwerx has been very good and very reassuring.  They have delivered very good service and I feel confident with the system installed due to this service.  Their salesperson, Daniel, gave me the confidence to decide on Solar Sunwerx.The installation of our 4.5kw system was on Wednesday 13/6 and it was inspected on Saturday 16/6.  The system is now up and running and we only have to wait for the appropriate paperwork to be finalised and the installation of a smart meter.I would not hesitate to recommend Solar Sunwerx to anybody as they have been very professional.  The installer, Sam Leighton, and his team arrived on time, installed the system and cleaned up afterwards.
Still waiting for system to be connected to the grid. Few problems with inverter. Hopefully getting sorted.

Really good service! Sales person made an effort to get the best option for us.Installers were quick and professional.Glad we made the decision to do Solar.Solar Sunwerx is highly recommended!Thanks Guys!

Solar Sunwerx was the only company that actually climbed up on the roof, measured, inspected our carport, and gave us a fixed quote on the day.  We anticipated problems with our carport and mentioned this, to be told that they were also builders and could fix any problems.  Sure enough on installation day some problems were encountered.  Instead of saying they couldn't install, the person who gave us the quote came out and fixed the carport there and then!  To say we were impressed is an understatement.  The system works well.  We are of course still waiting on our distributor to change our meter, but that delay has nothing to do with Solar Sunwerx, who were prompt in sending the relevant paperwork to our distributor and also our provider, and giving us a copy to show it had been sent.  They provided us with paperwork on the day of installation telling us what to do after installation to ensure the system is connected to the grid.  They were not the cheapest nor the most expensive quote.  All in all, we are very pleased and would recommend Solar Sunwerx without hesitation.
The Sales person was very professional and well versed. She was helpful and everything went like clockwork. Very pleased.

I considered the system finally chosen to be the best value.Karyn, the sales person and other Solar Sunwerx staff were all most helpful with a very wide range of questions during my extensive research.I'm hoping the installation and hardware measures up to the high standard experienced so far.I am looking forward to having the system installed, online and measuring its performance.

Our experience with Solar Sunwerx has been great. Daniel, the salesman who came to our home explained solar power to us in simple terms rather than technical jargon. His advice, product and no-pressure approach persuaded us to go with Sunwerx, even though the quote was slightly higher than a competitor. Sunwerx lived up to its promise of quick installation, and the installers, both A-grade electricians were fast and efficient and took the time to explain how the system works. Overall, Sunwerx took the sting out of what is for most households an important but very involved process.

I don't think we have had it long enough to give a valid summation of its value or quality. I am a little concerned that there will be issues down the track that were not honestly discussed during the quoting process relating to trees blocking the sun and our meter box possibly needing replacement.
All the red tape between the retailer and distributer is a pain.

Thank you to Solarquotes for your assistance and guidance in choosing solar energy. We chose solar Sunwerx because they kept in touch  without fuss   while we decided. They were also efficient  and cleaned up afterwards. They explained and showed me what the installation involved and then when all was finished the installers went back up on roof to do cosmetic improvements to the solar panels. Thank you again to every one involved.

Solar Sunwerx sent a representative to our site, checked it for suitability and we negotiated a price.  At all times we were kept informed with emails/paperwork, and there were no delays or excuses.  They followed up with all permits/authorizations in relation to the power supplier company.  Everything has gone very smoothly and we are happy with our decision.
The people at Sunwerx were fabulous!The contractors were polite and efficient.They even came back and double checked everything when we expressed doubts over the system's efficiency.

Installation was speedy & efficient with a real regard not only for maximum efficiency but also aesthetics. The inspector who came commented very favourably on the workmanship of the installation & said that he had never seen any fault with installations by Solar Sunwerx. In his experience their work was always first class.

We had three quotes for our solar - Solar Sunwerx, the Mark Group and Solargex.  The main point of difference between Solargex and the other two was that Solargex was selling German panels whilst the other two were Chinese (the other two were selling identical inverters, just different branded panels).  Consequently there was a difference in price, which we couldn't really afford, so we decided to go the Chinese panels.  Karen from Solar Sunwerx, although initially not the cheapest was increadibly helpful, patient and very switched on - and she didn't try the hard sell which was a real positive for me.The two guys that came to install the system were very professional.  They were lovely to me and my children and left the place very tidy.

The installation was professional, the inspection thorough. I had a technical query regarding the inverter, and following some intial discussion, the query was relayed to the Inverter manufacturer who responded with a satisfying answer within 24 hours.All of the staff from Solar Sunwerx that we had any interface with at all, treated me with respect. All in all, a pleasing experience in a world today where customer service is a dying art.Hence I am a very satisfied customer.
Only supplier that actual measured roof area and advised on what could be installed, other suppliers worked of google map image to get size of roof
Very helpful and transparent service. No hard sell. Lots of good practical advice. They also delayed installation due to weather to protect their subcontractors safety - which I applaud.

After a slow start  in receiving all our quotes for comparison I decided to go with Solar Sunwerx.Their representative was the only company that actually came to our residence for a sight inspection. His approach and knowledge on the product was very good, explaining in detail all my questions and not leaving anything to doubt.The installation was done actually a day earlier than was requested but they did ring prior to arrival creating no concerns as I was home anyway.Installation team were very good.

Over all I'm very happy with my system. Communication and follow-up by the company was excellent.Rep turned up when expected and scoped the building confirming my research and desired system was suitable and would do what I expected. Installer turned up early on the day and again explained evrything very well.  The paper work, after final inspection, was in within 10 days  to both my electricity retailer and distributor. I'm waiting on my distributor (which seems to be the main hold up for many people) to reprogram my new smart meter which installed in January, but, the sparkie that turned up to put in a new solar meter last week was not aware of this (had my old analogue meter serial no) - very poor internal communication on the part of the distribution company.
They go out of their way to help you and answer any question you ask. They tell you the truth and do not hassel you, they wait for you to get back to them.Even if it is much later.

It is difficult to determine what equipment is good or bad quality as there is very little a laymen can bench mark against - a limited knowledge of solar products prevents this. My choice of supplier was (like most) based on price and then it came to service. Solar Sunwerx were not the cheapest but the sales person kept in touch providing me with all the relevant details and answered all my questions in a timely and professional manner. The others did not. I researched 6 initial suppliers and rounded that down to 3. Of those three Solar Sunwerx provided the best pre-sales service. I am yet to have my system installed but I am happy with them thus far.
We were very pleased with Solar Sunwerx, nothing was any hassle to them, they told us a date when it would likely to be installed, and were here on that day.
Hard to say much as it's new and I hope the quality is good and as I haven't gotten my first electricty bill after the solar so can't really comment on how good it is.  I am very positive though.

They handled it efficiently and were able to answer questions about the system, the installation and what was going to happen fron inspection and connection. Great people. The rest just wanted an order.
Good customer service, good knowledge, helpful staff. Quick installation by friendly qualified people. Lots of information.

Unlike some other suppliers that I had spoken to, the salesman requested the opportunity to make an on-site inspection before final quote.Installation was quicker than expected, and carried out by a very efficient and professional team.Results so far have been very good, although electricity wholesaler is slow to complete installation of new meter.
Would recommend Solar Sunwerx to anyone requiring a quote, or even just some info.

Installers showed me how to turn on and off the system, were professional and efficient.Sunwerx back office follow up and responded promptly to any inquiries during and post installation.  I received electronic copies of all correspondence,compliance documents and work requests for electrical wholesaler which assisted when the wholesaler dropped the ball, asking for documents again that had been received 12 days before.... professional service from Sunwerx
I would suggest that anyone signing on for a Solar System would check with their prospective supplier first that all needed components are in stock, otherwise there could be a long wait.

Suppy of some components has been the only down fall installation is 4 weeks behind, however they have kept us informed all the way with constant phone calls and emails, so I cannot fault their service at this point.

We are waiting for our Smart meter before we turn it on.  We have a digital meter at the moment that can get confused and add on power that you produce to the bill.  We also paid a bit extra to get a hot water switch connected as the hot water service will not run on off peak when solar connected without one.  The difference with our installer compared to others was that they told us information that is essential to know as others even gave us false information.  You need to do your homework with your supplier and check out conditions of all suppliers on the DPI website.
Solar Sunwerx, were professional extremely helpful on every level.  Installation was great and the workers were fanastic.

Theses guys are really nice to deal with. They turn up when they say and get the job done in the time frame they said.  I also sent their quote to a friend who does solar in QLD and said it was a great system and fantastic price.We put this in winter so I will be looking forward to a summer to really see if it is worth it.
The system will be installed 3rd Sep if weather is ok.I will fill out this form again after that.

The salesman was very informative and in the end his information gave us a better understanding of the unit to go for which was a 2.88 kw. with a seperate hot water system. The service men have been very prompt attending on the day they stated amd earlier not later than the time stated. Which considered we are 1 hour out of melbourne was good. I have rated every thing good but better than average would be somewhere between good and fantastic.

the job was "fully installed". A local installer was contracted as we live in a rural area and it was easier to do rather get one of there blokes to travel. I was promised the panels woujd be angled to attract the max. yield when the on site inspection was conducted prior to installation.On the day a young man arrived, unloaded and left the panels and frame. by the time I got on to the roof the installer had already bolted down the first stages of theframe.  It was then sa part of his observation the direction of the panel were not in the optimal position to attract the most power and his bewilderment as to why he had been instructed to position the frame in its place. He estimated it would yield 5--7% loss in power.B y this time I was told it was to late to change things. Standing on the roof hearing this my eyes wandered over at the panels waiting to be fixed to the frame and then lifted into the correct angle.Ray the installer (interesting name for someone dedicated to only solar) is a fit man but i wondered how he was ever going to get all those panels and frame up by himself.  there were 12 panels@ 20kg plus the frame at several metres long, making a weight of over 240kg.Anyway we got it up ok but I given to believe "fully installed" was by the supplier not the purchaser.    There is more to tell but thats another story.
Great Company. Very Professional. I would recommend them highly.
learned a lot about solar energy and solar systems.Happy about producing bit of my electricity.

Its been 4 months since the finishing the installation. 6 months since signing agreement to purchase, and the system is still not connected to the electricity grid for the prccess of claiming the Government guarantee tariff rebate.After sales service is almost non existent, lots of phone calls and no return calls, they don't seem to know what is required, or what paper work is needed, for the new smart meters or interval meters. After spending $24,000 on a system, its ridiculous that its taking this long to complete...... I suggest you look for another installer..... NOT SATISFIED CUSTOMER..DON'T HOLDYOUR BREATH FOR A RETURN PHONE CALL
Solar Sunwerx customer service was the best, they keep you informed and was quick with the process.
